anchor.semantic_hook: The literal wish to have something for proof is staged as choosing one concrete exhibit and drawing it into an evidence clamp.
anchor.setting: A formal evidence hall contains a central stone plinth, an open brass clamp, shallow exhibit bays, and a semicircle of inspection lamps.
